RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your longer experience is relevant, but digital expertise, editorial judgment, leadership and interview performance may legitimately outweigh years served. Neither the appointment nor the unanswered request establishes discrimination.

Follow up in writing now. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred. Check any recruitment policy on panel composition.

Raise concerns about sex discrimination if specific evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments, inconsistent scoring or departures from policy. If you might challenge the decision, consult your union or a local employment adviser promptly: deadlines can be short.
